tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The category tree of 402post: for each category and subcategory its slug, when to use it, what it is not for, examples, the attributes it takes, and the number of live listings. Free. Call it first, or when validate_post says a category or subcategory is unknown.

tools.name: suggest_place
tools.description: Find the place id of a city for a listing's location. Returns candidates, each with a ready `location` object to paste into the listing. `country` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, for example BG) narrows the search. Free.

tools.name: validate_post
tools.description: Dry run of a listing: every problem comes back at once, by field, with the allowed values. Nothing is stored and nothing is charged. tools.description: Publish a listing: $0.10 USDC for 30 days, paid with x402 on Base. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_post" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Publish a listing: $0.10 USDC for 30 days, paid with x402 on Base. Without a payment this returns the payment requirements — exactly the body of HTTP 402 from P…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_post" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_post, search_posts, get_post · Private data: validate_post, create_post, search_posts, get_post · Public sink: validate_post, create_post, get_post · Destructive: validate_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_post, search_posts, get_post · Private data: validate_post, create_post, search_posts, get_post · Public sink: validate_post, create_post, get_post · Destructive: validate_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
